verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in feature that analyzes a user's data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. The closest items are AI-assisted error debugging and AI agent building, which are related but different features and earn no credit here. Users could build insight-generating workflows themselves with custom code, but that is a developer building block, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
